    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend the diagonal of 5s up-left from its upper endpoint.
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if len(pts) >= 2:
        pts.sort()
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = pts[:2]
        dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
        r, c = r1 - dr, c1 - dc
        while 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):
            if out[r][c] != 9:
                break
            out[r][c] = 5
            r -= dr
            c -= dc
    # Extend the diagonal of 3s and 8s/4s/2s in each direction as shown by their lines.
    # General rule: each colored diagonal streak is continued from its endpoints.
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 9}:
        pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        pts.sort()
        dr, dc = pts[1][0] - pts[0][0], pts[1][1] - pts[0][1]
        if not dr or not dc:
            continue
        for r, c, step in ((pts[0][0], pts[0][1], -1), (pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1], 1)):
            while 0 <= r + step * dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + step * dc < len(out[0]):
                r += step * dr
                c += step * dc
                if out[r][c] != 9:
                    break
                out[r][c] = color
